name: THE PRINCE IS A 10, BUT...
source:
A dark fantasy comedy survival VN set in a classic Fairytale Winter! Play as a stoic Princess, trapped in a tower guarded by a monster.

Multiple Princes show up to rescue you – except there’s just one problem: every Prince has a major character flaw, hindering your chance at making it out of the tower alive.

Choose from 5 Princes, try to escape the tower, and survive: with or without him!

[From [url=https://beauvdalen.itch.io/the-prince-is-a-10-but-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
